Name: Refitted Winter Tree Sprites
Author: JefGrizli
Description:
[b][color=#93c47d]Mod Authors: Feel free to use the winter sprites as you like; in a recolour, forage mod, you name it.[/color][/b]
[color=#b6b6b6]A VPR version is included in Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn.[/color]



[u]Compatibility[/u]
Do I have to say it? NOT compatible with any other mod targeting fruit trees (both vanilla and SVE). No exceptions made.
The priority is set to [color=#e06666][b]Late[/b][/color].


[u]Config Options[/u]
You can choose between the vanilla colour scheme for fruit trees or the [color=#f6b26b]colour scheme variant[/color], which changes all fruit trees' colour scheme to the vanilla default for other deciduous trees.

Manifest.Name: Refitted Winter Tree Sprites
Manifest.Description: Redrawing of vanilla fruit tree winter sprites. Makes apricot and peach trees bloom pink.
